blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of the current five-view and six-pose V64 render set shows angular, irregular clumped folds across the overskirt and an asymmetric pointed split-front hem. The skirt does not read as controlled continuous fabric drape.

Direct inspection of the current sit and crouch renders shows rounded shorts-like thigh shells protruding above and ahead of the overskirt. Narrow separated front panels leave anterior thighs visibly uncovered; motion and coverage remain unacceptable.
The current full-body back render shows only a small low-contrast waist detail; the adjustment tab function is not readable at this scale and no close-up evidence exists.

Current source-bound mesh showcase reports UV status PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED: 1 of 7 objects has source-authored UV coordinates, 2 active UVMap layers are provenance-unverified, and 4 objects report UV not created. No replacement or automatic UVs were generated.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
